messages.docx.edit.help: Write checked annotations back to DOCX. Validate the whole selection, back up, then replace atomically; annotation statuses are unchanged.
messages.docx.edit.batchHelp: Apply open quick edits in this batch; with replace, assign the backup to this batch
messages.docx.edit.idHelp: Apply this annotation; repeat for more IDs
messages.docx.edit.paragraphHelp: Main-document paragraph number, starting at 0 (as shown by notes.py show)
messages.docx.edit.outputHelp: Write to a new file that does not exist; preserve the source
messages.docx.edit.dryHelp: Check and preview without writing a document or backup
messages.docx.edit.untrackedHelp: Explicitly allow untracked changes while Track Changes is enabled; paragraphs with native revisions remain read-only
messages.docx.edit.untracked: AE writes untracked changes; it does not create native Word revision records.
messages.docx.edit.preview: Preview passed: {path}; paragraphs: {paragraphs}. No document or annotation status has been changed.
messages.docx.edit.done: Written: {path}; paragraphs: {paragraphs}. Rebuild the review page and check each change before recording annotation results.
messages.docx.edit.error.xml: The XML cannot be edited safely ({detail}); save a new DOCX in Word and rebuild the review page.
messages.docx.edit.error.encoding: Write-back does not support UTF-16 or other non-UTF-8 XML; save a UTF-8 DOCX in Word and rebuild the review page.
messages.docx.edit.error.size: The document or its expanded parts exceed the write-back size limit; edit it in Word.
messages.docx.edit.error.characters: The replacement contains characters invalid in XML 1.0; remove control characters or unpaired surrogates and retry.
messages.docx.edit.error.anchor: The paragraph location is missing, stale, or unsupported; rebuild the review page and quote the intended text again after checking it.
messages.docx.edit.error.range: A range spanning paragraphs, tabs, symbols, or line-break structures cannot be written back automatically; split it into plain-text changes within each paragraph, or edit in Word.
messages.docx.edit.error.empty: There are no quick edits to apply, or the original text is empty; specify a batch, annotation, or original text.
messages.docx.edit.error.notFound: The target paragraph or original text did not match; check the location and quote, then rebuild the review page before retrying.
messages.docx.edit.error.ambiguous: Several paragraphs or text ranges match; quote the exact range again on the review page.
messages.docx.edit.error.readonly: The target paragraph contains {detail} and cannot be written back automatically; edit it in Word.
messages.docx.edit.error.overlap: Selected edits overlap; nothing was written. Combine or resolve the conflicting edits first.
messages.docx.edit.error.package: This DOCX package structure is unsupported (for example ZIP64, split archives, duplicate members, encryption, or Strict OOXML); save a new copy in Word and rebuild.
messages.docx.edit.error.signed: The document has a digital signature that editing would invalidate; retain the signed original, prepare an unsigned copy in Word, and generate a new review page.
messages.docx.edit.error.protected: Editing protection is enabled; an authorized person must remove it in Word and rebuild the review page before editing.
messages.docx.edit.error.tracked: Track Changes is enabled, so write-back is refused by default. Add --allow-untracked only when untracked edits are intended. AE writes untracked changes.
messages.docx.edit.error.validation: Post-write validation failed ({detail}); the original was not replaced. Its backup remains in the review directory under .snapshots.
messages.docx.edit.error.source: The source cannot be read or the backup directory is unsafe; check the source path in review.json and the .snapshots directory.
messages.docx.edit.error.locked: A Word owner file (~$) exists; close this document in Word/WPS and confirm the lock has been released before retrying.
messages.docx.edit.error.fingerprint: The source fingerprint differs from the version used to build the review page; rebuild and recheck annotations first. There is no force-overwrite option.
messages.docx.edit.error.output: The output already exists or is a symbolic link: {detail}; choose a new output path.
messages.docx.edit.error.batch: Batch {detail} was not found; check its number with notes.py batches.
messages.docx.edit.error.note: The annotation is missing, resolved, unconfirmed, on hold, or is not a report-side quick edit; check it with notes.py show.
messages.docx.edit.error.review: This is not a supported DOCX review; build a review page with the current build_viewer.py --report document.docx.
messages.docx.edit.error.arguments: For apply, choose either --batch or --id. For replace, supply --paragraph, --from, and --to. Batch numbers must be positive integers.
messages.docx.edit.error.io: Write-back did not complete ({detail}); any original backup already created remains in .snapshots. Check permissions and document integrity.
messages.viewer.docx.unlocatedEdit: This selection spans paragraphs or lacks a reliable paragraph location and cannot be written back automatically; quote text within one paragraph again, or edit it in Word.

messages.docx.edit.cli.missingArgument: A write-back command or review directory is missing; use --help for usage
